title.en: Directed writing and proposal: exam practice

hook.en: Directed writing and proposals are marked on three things: the right format, all the required content, and clear expression. Practice turns these into habits.

objectives.en: Check an answer against format, content and expression
Turn given notes into complete points without copying
Correct common format mistakes in articles, reports, speeches and proposals

narration.en: Directed writing and proposals are marked on three things: the right format, all the required content, and clear expression. Practice turns these into habits.

body.en: Questions supply notes, data or a situation. Every point given must appear in your answer, but expanded into full sentences and connected logically, not copied as a list. Add relevant ideas of your own to show thought. Keep the role, the audience and the purpose in view throughout: a report by a student reporter should not suddenly use "I think"; a speech to juniors should be simple and warm; a proposal to the principal should be formal and practical.

explanation.en: Each form has its own conventions; mixing them (letter endings in speeches, greetings in notices) loses format marks.

body.en: Expression covers accuracy (grammar, spelling, punctuation), vocabulary (precise, varied, suitable) and organisation (paragraphs, links). Register means the level of formality: proposals, reports, notices and formal emails are formal and impersonal; school-magazine articles and speeches to students may be warmer and more personal; reviews are evaluative. Avoid contractions and slang in formal pieces, and avoid stiff, borrowed phrases in friendly ones.

points.en: Warmer: magazine article, speech to students
No slang or contractions in formal writing

text.en: It is proposed that the library remain open until 6 p.m.
We gotta keep the library open longer, guys!
The event was attended by over two hundred residents.
Tons of people came and it was awesome.

explanation.en: Formal writing uses complete words, impersonal or polite structures and no slang or text-message spellings.

problem.en: Turn these notes into a paragraph for a report: "tree plantation – 15 Aug – school campus – 200 saplings – NSS volunteers – Forest Officer chief guest – maintenance roster".

steps.en: A tree plantation drive was organised on the school campus on 15 August.
Two hundred saplings were planted by NSS volunteers in the presence of the District Forest Officer, who was the chief guest.
A maintenance roster has been drawn up so that each class waters and cares for its own row of saplings.

answer.en: Every note is used, expanded into full sentences, in the past tense and the passive where natural.
